_guide: How to add a contributor. Copy one of the entries inside "contributors", change its values and save. The app reads this file at startup, so just add the entry and rebuild. Fields: "username" is required (GitHub profile handle; the avatar is fetched automatically from https://github.com/<username>.png); "name" is optional and overrides the displayed name (defaults to the username); "description" is a short neutral text in English (it is intentionally not translated, so it reads the same in every language); "url" is optional and defaults to https://github.com/<username>. Example entry: { "username": "octocat", "name": "Octo Cat", "description": "Helps triage issues and answers questions in the community." }

contributors.description: Contributes massively by testing VIVI Music DE on macOS (Apple Silicon) and providing feedback — including technical feedback — across every area of the app.
Always available to help those in need in the Telegram channel, even without a PC.
Created the Android app that VIVI Music DE is based on, and keeps the project — and its developer — in line.
Created the foundation of the new UX — without him, this would not exist.
